questions.question: What is the penalty for illegally passing a stopped school bus?

options.text: Loss of driving privileges or vehicle registration and a $300 fine.
A 60-day suspension of driving privileges.
A $30 fine and 14-day suspension of driving privileges.

questions.correctAnswerText: Loss of driving privileges or vehicle registration and a $300 fine.
questions.explanation: If you pass a stopped school bus with flashing lights and its stop arm out, you will lose your driver's license, pay a $300 fine, and do community service. The court decides how much community service. If you were not driving the vehicle, the owner must tell the State's Attorney's Office who was driving. If they don't, their vehicle registration will be suspended for three months.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Railroad crossing.
Warning.
Signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning.
questions.explanation: A yellow diamond-shaped sign warns you of danger ahead. Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of dangers near construction work areas.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly goes flat while you are driving, you should:

options.text: Pump the brake pedal several times quickly.
Slow down gradually without using the brakes.
Press the brake pedal down as hard as you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down gradually without using the brakes.
questions.explanation: If a tire goes flat, hold the steering wheel firmly and keep the vehicle straight. Take your foot off the accelerator and do not brake. Let the vehicle slow down on its own. Use the brakes gently only if you need to. Pull off the road safely when you can.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height for a vehicle in this state.
The maximum width for a vehicle on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this case, it is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: When entering the interstate on a short entrance ramp with no acceleration lane, you should:

options.text: Move to the far-right lane and speed up to match traffic immediately.
Use the shoulder to speed up to match traffic.
Speed up only after you see a gap in traffic, then enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up only after you see a gap in traffic, then enter.
questions.explanation: On a short entrance ramp without an acceleration lane, wait for a gap in traffic before you speed up and enter the interstate. You should be stopped while waiting for a gap to appear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle has the right-of-way.
Slow-moving vehicle.
Shoulder work ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicle.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and animal carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: Is it legal to wear a dual ear headset while driving?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: In Illinois, it is illegal to use any headset (except hearing aids) while driving. You cannot use a device that lets you hear or receive electronic communications. However, you can use a single-sided earpiece with a wireless phone. Motorcycle and moped riders may use helmet intercom systems to talk to passengers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws they must follow. This sign means you must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: Can you pass another vehicle by driving on the shoulder of the road?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: You cannot leave the pavement or the main road to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: You drive defensively when you:

options.text: Keep one car length between you and the car ahead.
Look only at the car directly in front of you.
Keep your eyes moving to spot possible dangers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your eyes moving to spot possible dangers.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means looking ahead for possible dangers. Only staring at the road right in front of you is dangerous. Scan ahead and watch for vehicles around you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Side road.
Merge.
Yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Side road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: A solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line means that vehicles:

options.text: Driving in both directions may pass.
Next to the broken line may pass.
Next to the solid line may pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Next to the broken line may pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. If you have a broken yellow line next to your lane, you may pass other vehicles.

questions.question: When entering traffic after being parked at a curb, you:

options.text: Should drive more slowly than other traffic for 200 feet.
Should wait for a large enough gap to get up to the speed of traffic.
Should wait for the first two vehicles to pass, then drive into the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should wait for a large enough gap to get up to the speed of traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging into traffic, wait for a gap large enough to match the speed of other vehicles.

questions.question: You must use your low beams any time you are:

options.text: On a lighted street.
On a freeway.
In fog.

questions.correctAnswerText: In fog.
questions.explanation: Use low beams in fog, snow, rain, or mist. High beams reflect off water and create glare, making it harder to see. Fog lights can be used with low beams.

questions.question: At night, an oncoming vehicle has its high beams on and is blinding you. You should:

options.text: Look ahead toward the left edge of your lane.
Look ahead toward the right edge of your lane.
Look straight ahead in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead toward the right edge of your lane.
questions.explanation: Do not look directly at oncoming headlights. Instead, look toward the right edge of your lane and watch the other vehicle from the corner of your eye.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road construction/maintenance area.
Side road.
Railroad ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road construction/maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped orange signs warn of hazards. Orange is used for construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: While driving on a roadway with a single broken white centerline:

options.text: You must stay within your lane.
You may cross the centerline to change lanes.
You may change lanes only from the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may cross the centerline to change lanes.
questions.explanation: White lines show lanes going the same direction. A broken white line means you can pass another vehicle when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
No right turn.
No passing zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is curving or getting narrower. You may see these signs before sharp curves or narrow bridges.

questions.question: Adjust your rearview and side mirrors:

options.text: Before you start driving.
Whenever you need to use them.
Before you get into the car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Adjust your mirrors before moving your vehicle. Also adjust your seat, fasten your safety belt, and secure loose items. Never adjust mirrors while driving.

questions.question: An orange sign means drivers should be alert, adjust their speed, and be prepared to stop if necessary.

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of dangers in construction or maintenance areas. Slow down and be ready to stop when you see these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Dangerous intersections.
Slow-moving vehicles.
Yield signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicles.
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right.
No right turns permitted.
Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turns permitted.
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: "No passing zone" signs tell drivers:

options.text: To speed up slightly.
That it is not safe to pass.
To maintain a steady speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: That it is not safe to pass.
questions.explanation: A "No passing zone" sign means you cannot pass another vehicle in that area. You are likely in a place with poor visibility where passing would be unsafe.

questions.question: When approaching an intersection with a flashing red light, you must:

options.text: Come to a complete stop, yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians, then proceed.
Reduce your speed and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop and remain stopped as long as the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians, then proceed.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Stop completely, make sure it is safe, then proceed.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection, you should:

options.text: Yield to all traffic before crossing the intersection.
Stop, then enter the intersection when it is safe to do so.
Slow down and cross the intersection carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and cross the intersection carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down to a safe speed and proceed with caution.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should never:

options.text: Cross the centerline in an intersection.
Check your blind spots by looking over your left or right shoulder.
Check for other drivers moving into the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross the centerline in an intersection.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your blind spot by looking over your shoulder and check for other drivers in the same lane. Never change lanes or pass inside an intersection.

questions.question: When parking next to a curb, you should use your turn signals:

options.text: Only when pulling away from the curb.
When pulling next to, but not away from, the curb.
When pulling next to or away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pulling next to or away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Use your turn signal both when pulling up to a curb and when pulling away from a curb.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions ahead. This sign tells you to slow down for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: You should yield to a pedestrian:

options.text: Only if they are in a crosswalk.
At all times, even if the pedestrian is not obeying traffic laws.
Only if the traffic lights are in the pedestrian's favor.

questions.correctAnswerText: At all times, even if the pedestrian is not obeying traffic laws.
questions.explanation: Always watch for pedestrians near your vehicle. Do everything you can to avoid hitting a pedestrian, no matter the circumstances.
